{{Quote|I represent the interests of a merchants' association here on Manaan.|Shak Los|<ref name="TOR:ACP" />}}
'''Shak Los''' was a [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] antiques dealer who sometimes used less than legal means to acquire his wares.

==Biography==
{{Quote|My associates and I trade in unique items difficult to procure through conventional means. We have many collectors interested in artifacts from a lost city in the Asutvu Rift. Treasures that we are unable to provide. A cult has firmly embedded themselves in the city's ruins. No one can even approach, let alone enter the site.|Shak Los|<ref name="TOR:ACP" />}}
Born to a wealthy merchant family on [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]], Shak was initially reluctant to join the family business, until his mother presented him with an ultimatum; either join, or be cut off. Reluctantly he joined his father's business, however, with the help of one of his father's business partners, began to grow his own business on the side. Meanwhile, he also learnt to deal with less legal methods of doing business. Eventually, he amassed enough wealth to buy out his father's exporting business, changing it from exporting to antiques dealing.<ref name="codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
The player only interacts with Shak Los if they sided with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. In that, whilst the player is searching for information about [[Kolto/Legends|Kolto]] deposits on Manaan, Shak will steal the data and ask the player to kill [[the Conservator]], who has taken over an old city he want to steal artefacts from. After doing so, the play has the option to kill Shak, if they wish, or let him free.<ref name="TOR:ACP" />
